entries.label: INIT_HELLO
entries.body:
Hello my little one. I am so pleased to see you!
You have done well for yourself.
It is gratifying.
entries.source:
Hello my little one. I am so pleased to see you!
You have done well for yourself.
It is gratifying.
entries.translation:
你好啊，我的小寶貝。 真高興見到你！
你把自己照顧得很好。
令人欣慰。

entries.label: confused_by_hello
entries.body: You sound as if you know me. Have we met?
entries.source: You sound as if you know me. Have we met?
entries.translation: 你聽起來好像認識我。 我們見過嗎？

entries.label: CONFUSED_RESPONSE
entries.body:
I forget myself. Of course you don't know me. You are from Unzervalt, not Earth.
We are, however, how shall I say, related.
It has been many of your years since I have been to our planet Earth.
We are known among your kind by many names... some of them flattering, some of them not.
The one we use most often was given to us by the children of the Celts. A wonderful culture!
They called us the Arilou... the Arilou Lalee'lay.
More recently we were part of the Alliance of Free Stars, along with your kind
until we decided to return to our own....oh, how would you say... reality
when it became clear that your people would be safe enough under the Ur-Quan slave shield.

entries.translation:
是我忘了分寸。 你當然不認識我。 你來自翁澤沃特， 不是地球。
不過，該怎麼說呢， 我們之間算是有些關係。
以你們的時間來算， 我已經很多年沒去過我們的 地球了。
你們族人用許多名字稱呼我 們……有些中聽， 有些不然。
我們最常用的名字， 是凱爾特人的子孫所取。 真是個美妙的文化！
他們稱我們為阿里盧…… 阿里盧・拉萊萊。
比較近代時，我們曾與你們 同為自由星辰聯盟的一員
直到我們確定你們在烏爾關 的奴役護盾下已經足夠安全
才決定返回自己的……喔， 用你們的話怎麼說…… 現實。

entries.label: happy_by_hello
entries.body: I know who you are! You're Arilou!! We've wondered what happened to your people for a long time.
entries.source: I know who you are! You're Arilou!! We've wondered what happened to your people for a long time.
entries.translation: 我知道你是誰！ 你是阿里盧！！ 我們一直很想知道你們族人 究竟發生了什麼事。

entries.label: HAPPY_RESPONSE
entries.body:
You are very clever!
Yes, I am Arilou Lalee'lay and I suppose it has been a very long time since you've met one of my kind.
I imagine you humans are still very short lived. How sad.
Ah well. To answer your question, we chose to cease our efforts with the Alliance of Free Stars
when it seemed that there was no longer any threat to our Earthlings.
I am pleased to see that you, from outside the slave shield, survived. You seem healthy.

entries.translation:
你真聰明！
沒錯，我是阿里盧・拉萊 萊；我想你確實已經很久沒 見過我的同族了。
你們人類的壽命大概還是很 短。真令人難過。
好吧，回答你的問題： 當地球人似乎已不再面臨任 何威脅時
我們選擇停止為自由星辰聯 盟效力。
很高興看見來自奴役護盾外 的你活了下來。 你看起來很健康。

entries.label: miffed_by_hello
entries.body: I'll be. It's the Arilou. Why the hell did you run out on the Alliance of Free Stars? What happened?
entries.source: I'll be. It's the Arilou. Why the hell did you run out on the Alliance of Free Stars? What happened?
entries.translation: 真想不到，是阿里盧。 你們到底為什麼拋下自由星 辰聯盟？發生了什麼事？

entries.label: MIFFED_RESPONSE
entries.body:
You're annoyed. How interesting.
It has been so long since I dealt with Humans. I had forgotten what it was like.
Now let's see, how shall I best appease you? Yes, if I remember, an honest answer would help.
We didn't exactly 'run out' on the Alliance.
We chose to leave when there was no longer a reason to stay.
You humans seemed safe enough under the Ur-Quan slave shield.
In fact, we rather liked the idea and wished we had thought of it ourselves.
For your safety of course.

entries.translation:
你生氣了。真有意思。
我已經太久沒和人類打交 道，幾乎忘了那是什麼感 覺。
讓我想想，怎樣最能安撫 你？對了，沒記錯的話， 坦白回答應該有用。
我們並不算是「拋下」聯 盟。
只是當再也沒有留下來的理 由時，選擇了離開。
你們人類待在烏爾關的奴役 護盾下，看來已經足夠安 全。
事實上，我們很喜歡這個主 意，甚至希望是自己先想到 的。
當然，都是為了你們的安 全。

entries.label: FRIENDLY_SPACE_HELLO_1
entries.body:
Ah... our human friend. Please, let us chat a while.
It has been so many years since I last visited your Earth
so long since I glided across your open fields under the light of a full moon.
Tell me of Earth. Tell me what I have... oh, I forget myself... how silly.
You were born on the distant world Unzervalt.
I have visited there much more recently.

entries.translation:
啊……我們的人類朋友。 來，陪我們聊一會兒吧。
距離我上次造訪你們的地 球，已經過了好多年
也很久不曾在滿月光芒下滑 過你們開闊的原野。
說說地球吧。告訴我錯過了 什麼……喔，是我忘了…… 真傻。
你出生在遙遠的翁澤沃特。
我倒是比較近期才去過那 裡。

entries.label: FRIENDLY_SPACE_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Hello my clever child. We have met again and I am pleased.
Your people are so beautiful... so unspoiled.
Your instincts are like perfume... your motives a shimmering crystal.
entries.source:
Hello my clever child. We have met again and I am pleased.
Your people are so beautiful... so unspoiled.
Your instincts are like perfume... your motives a shimmering crystal.
entries.translation:
你好啊，我聰明的孩子。 我們又見面了， 真令人高興。
你們族人如此美麗…… 如此純真。
你們的本能如香氣…… 動機則像閃爍的水晶。

entries.label: FRIENDLY_SPACE_HELLO_3
entries.body:
Last night as you slept, I touched your face and you smiled!...
but now you frown. A pity. Smiling is healthier.
entries.source:
Last night as you slept, I touched your face and you smiled!...
but now you frown. A pity. Smiling is healthier.
entries.translation:
昨晚你睡著時， 我摸了摸你的臉， 而你笑了！……
但現在你皺著眉。真可惜。 微笑比較健康。

entries.label: FRIENDLY_SPACE_HELLO_4
entries.body: Did you desire this meeting, Captain, or did we?
entries.source: Did you desire this meeting, Captain, or did we?
entries.translation: 船長，是你渴望這次相遇， 還是我們呢？

entries.label: FRDLY_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_1
entries.body:
Ha-ha! Our clever ward has found our nook in *time*!
You are the first, brave human! No others have made the trip.
This is our homeworld, Falayalaralfali, nestled safe in this TrueSpace eddy.
The portal you passed through is a rarity, a natural point of interdimensional fatigue.
We use these phenomena to speed our transit through the realities.
We are wondering, have you met with the Umgah recently?
We entrusted an injured Talking Pet into their care
and we were curious about its progress.

entries.translation:
哈－哈！我們聰明的受監護 人，在*時間*之中找到了 我們的小窩！
你是第一位，勇敢的人類！ 還沒有別人成功走完這趟旅 程。
這裡就是我們的母星法拉亞 拉法利，安穩地依偎在這股 常規空間渦流中。
你穿過的傳送門非常罕見， 是一處天然的跨維度疲勞 點。
我們利用這些現象， 加速穿越不同現實。
我們想知道，你最近見過烏 姆加嗎？
我們將一隻受傷的會說話的 寵物託付給他們照料
很好奇牠恢復得如何。

entries.label: FRDLY_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Welcome back to Falayalaralfali, Captain.
Perhaps, in the fullness of time we will let you visit the surface of our world.
There are many beauties here unmatched anywhere... the Mountain Clouds of Thought
the Tangible Wish... the Dark. Unfortunately, you are not yet... acclimated.
Premature exposure to these would render you... numb.

entries.translation:
歡迎回到法拉亞拉法利， 船長。
也許等時機成熟， 我們會讓你造訪這個世界的 地表。
這裡有許多其他地方無可比 擬的美景……思想山雲
有形之願……黑暗。可惜， 你還沒有……適應。
過早接觸這些事物， 會使你變得……麻木。

entries.label: FRDLY_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_3
entries.body:
Hello. We are pleased to see you again. Have you any numbness yet?
Good. It should be too soon for that. Too soon by far.
entries.source:
Hello. We are pleased to see you again. Have you any numbness yet?
Good. It should be too soon for that. Too soon by far.
entries.translation:
你好。很高興再次見到你。 你已經感到麻木了嗎？
很好。現在應該還太早。 早得多。

entries.label: FRDLY_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_4
entries.body: Yes, Captain. What can the Arilou Lalee'lay of Falayalaralfali do for you this day?
entries.source: Yes, Captain. What can the Arilou Lalee'lay of Falayalaralfali do for you this day?
entries.translation: 是的，船長。法拉亞拉法利 的阿里盧・拉萊萊， 今天能為你做什麼？

entries.label: whats_up_1
entries.body: What exactly IS your connection with Earth and Humans, anyway?
entries.source: What exactly IS your connection with Earth and Humans, anyway?
entries.translation: 你們和地球及人類之間， 到底有什麼關係？

entries.label: whats_up_2
entries.body: I'm still confused about our relationship. Please elaborate.
entries.source: I'm still confused about our relationship. Please elaborate.
entries.translation: 我還是搞不懂我們的關係。 請說清楚一點。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_1
entries.body:
You are curious. That is a promising quality.
How can I describe our relation to Humans?...
Never doubt our motives, Captain. Your well-being is of paramount concern to every Arilou.
Surely you know, that it was the day after Humanity joined the Alliance Of Free Stars
that we appeared in the open for the first time. This was no coincidence.
We wanted to protect you. Once we saw that you were...well, safe
we decided to tend to other business for a short while.
Believe me, Captain, we have known each other for a very long time.
You might even say that we knew the first human.

entries.translation:
你很好奇。這是個前途可期 的特質。
該怎麼描述我們與人類的關 係呢？……
絕不要懷疑我們的動機， 船長。每個阿里盧最關心的 都是你的安危。
你一定知道，人類加入自由 星辰聯盟的隔天
我們便首度公開現身。 這並非巧合。
我們想保護你們。 一看見你們已經……嗯， 安全了
便決定暫時去處理其他事 務。
相信我，船長， 我們早已相識非常、 非常久。
你甚至可以說， 我們認識第一個人類。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_2
entries.body:
You have painted our pictures on cave walls, erected standing stones and pyramids for us.
You have wondered at our signs to each other in your wheat fields
and written books about our more personal endeavors
when we allowed you to recall our examinations.
We have a history together, Captain, and you have come a long way.
But I must tread carefully. You are not ready for everything
and I fear that you would not understand what was best for you.

entries.translation:
你們曾把我們的模樣畫在洞 穴牆上，為我們豎立巨石與 金字塔。
你們曾驚嘆我們在麥田中彼 此留下的記號
也曾寫書描述那些更私密的 行動
在我們允許你們回想起檢查 過程的時候。
我們共享一段歷史，船長， 而你們已經走了很遠。
但我必須小心行事。 你還沒準備好知道一切
而且恐怕你不會明白， 什麼才是對你最好的。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_3
entries.body:
As you know, we never revealed where in the galaxy one could find our homeworld.
There was a good reason. We are not from your space, or your... *time*.
Some of your more broad thinkers refer to such realms as other dimensions.
Though trivialized, this is a suitable metaphor for your intellect.
Perhaps you know of the Orz. Like us, they are dimensional travellers
but that is where our similarity ends.
Do not trust the Orz, my Human Captain. They are dangerous.
But as to your question... our relationship
To call our interaction with your kind an experiment would be much too simple and impersonal.
Let us just say that we have a vested interest in your... development.
You are one of our... extended family, just as other sentients in other dimensions
have their extended families.
We are proud of you as you would be of your children, and some day
well, I have said too much already.

entries.translation:
你已經知道，我們從未透露 要在銀河何處才能找到母 星。
這有充分理由。 我們並非來自你們的空間， 或你們的……*時間*。
你們之中思想比較開闊的 人，會把這類領域稱為其他 維度。
儘管過度簡化， 對你們的理解力而言倒是恰 當的比喻。
也許你知道奧茲。 他們和我們一樣， 都是維度旅行者
但相似之處到此為止。
不要信任奧茲， 我的人類船長。 他們很危險。
不過回到你的問題…… 我們的關係
若把我們與你們族人的互動 稱為實驗，未免太過簡單而 冷漠。
就只說，我們對你們的…… 發展，有著切身利害關係 吧。
你是我們……大家族的一分 子，正如其他維度中的其他 智慧生命
也有他們的大家族。
我們以你為榮， 就像你會以自己的孩子為 榮，而終有一天
好吧，我已經說得太多了。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_4
entries.body:
You already know more than is appropriate. In fact, you may represent an unfortunate complication.
You have been in the stars for much time. Do you seek the doorway, or are you just passing through?
Remember, you can only go over naturally for the three days it is open.
How to find it? Look on your starmap from 17 through 20. The variable star shall be your guide.

entries.translation:
你已知道太多不該知道的 事。事實上，你可能會造成 令人遺憾的變數。
你已在群星之間待了很久。 你在尋找門口， 還是只想路過？
記住，只有它開啟的三天 內，你才能自然穿越。
怎麼找到它？在十七日至二 十日查看星圖。 那顆變星會為你引路。

entries.label: why_you_here
entries.body: What are you doing here, in this region of space?
entries.source: What are you doing here, in this region of space?
entries.translation: 你們在這片太空區域做什 麼？

entries.label: LEARN_THINGS
entries.body:
We are many places, at many *times*. This place is an easy place... one of the ten easy places.
At different times, we explore different easy places. That is our way.
Oh! I can see from the look in your eyes that I have confused you.  I am silly.
Please disregard my words.
entries.source:

At different times, we explore different easy places. That is our way.
Oh! I can see from the look in your eyes that I have confused you.  I am silly.
Please disregard my words.
entries.translation:
我們同時身在許多地方、 許多*時間*。 這個地方很容易…… 是十個容易之地之一。
在不同時間，我們探索不同 的容易之地。這就是我們的 方式。
喔！從你的眼神， 我看得出自己把你弄糊塗 了。  我真傻。
請別把我的話放在心上。

entries.label: what_things
entries.body: What are you exploring for in these `easy places'?
entries.source: What are you exploring for in these `easy places'?
entries.translation: 你們在這些`容易之地'探 索什麼？

entries.label: THESE_THINGS
entries.body:
We seek to trap *Nnngn*, but they dart and leap.
YOU cannot trap *Nnngn*... do not even try.
I do not think you can even touch them; you are not quite solid enough.
entries.source:
We seek to trap *Nnngn*, but they dart and leap.
YOU cannot trap *Nnngn*... do not even try.
I do not think you can even touch them; you are not quite solid enough.
entries.translation:
我們想捕捉*Nnngn *，但牠們總是竄跳閃躲。
你無法捕捉*Nnngn *……連試都不要試。
我想你甚至碰不到牠們； 你還不夠凝實。

entries.label: why_do_it
entries.body: Okay, you trap these nungy things. Then what?
entries.source: Okay, you trap these nungy things. Then what?
entries.translation: 好吧，你們會抓那些 Nnngn 之類的東西。然後呢？

entries.label: DO_IT_BECAUSE
entries.body:
Why we let them go, of course! *Nnngn* do not like to be confined!
Captain, these things we talk about... they are unimportant to you... they are as dreams.
Our words should address your universe... not ours.
entries.source:
Why we let them go, of course! *Nnngn* do not like to be confined!
Captain, these things we talk about... they are unimportant to you... they are as dreams.
Our words should address your universe... not ours.
entries.translation:
當然是放走牠們！ *Nnngn*不喜歡被關 起來！
船長，我們談的這些事…… 對你並不重要…… 它們就像夢一樣。
我們的話題應該圍繞你的宇 宙……不是我們的。

entries.label: give_me_info_1
entries.body: We still struggle against the Ur-Quan. Can you help us?
entries.source: We still struggle against the Ur-Quan. Can you help us?
entries.translation: 我們仍在對抗烏爾關。 你能幫助我們嗎？

entries.label: ARILOU_HINTS_1
entries.body:
With ships and weapons... blood and bones... no.
Too many shipmates were forcibly... discorporated.. in the last conflict.
Our cooperation is not necessary. You are the focus.
However, knowledge transcends reality perimeters, and this we can share with you.
An example: to discover the nature of the red probes
seek creatures who inhabit a world with no surface.
entries.source:
With ships and weapons... blood and bones... no.
Too many shipmates were forcibly... discorporated.. in the last conflict.
Our cooperation is not necessary. You are the focus.
However, knowledge transcends reality perimeters, and this we can share with you.
An example: to discover the nature of the red probes
seek creatures who inhabit a world with no surface.
entries.translation:
用船艦與武器…… 鮮血與白骨……不行。
上次衝突中，太多同船夥伴 被迫……脫離肉身……
我們不必合作。焦點是你。
然而，知識能跨越現實的疆 界，而這正是我們能與你分 享的。
舉個例子：若想查明紅色探 測器的本質
去尋找居住在無地表世界上 的生物。

entries.label: give_me_info_2
entries.body: Can you give us any more information?
entries.source: Can you give us any more information?
entries.translation: 你能再提供一些情報嗎？

entries.label: ARILOU_HINTS_2
entries.body:
The Mycon change and reform worlds with their Deep Children.
These changes affect others unfortunately.
The fate of your world and your heart relate to these matters.
entries.source:
The Mycon change and reform worlds with their Deep Children.
These changes affect others unfortunately.
The fate of your world and your heart relate to these matters.
entries.translation:
邁康利用深淵之子改造並重 塑世界。
遺憾的是，這些改變會波及 他者。
你的世界與你的心， 命運都與此事相連。

entries.label: ARILOU_HINTS_3
entries.body:
The carnate forces of Ur-Quan and Kohr-Ah are twined about the memory of pain.
They respond to these words.
Hold! What you are doing to us is wrong! Why do you do this thing?
entries.source:
The carnate forces of Ur-Quan and Kohr-Ah are twined about the memory of pain.
They respond to these words.
Hold! What you are doing to us is wrong! Why do you do this thing?
entries.translation:
烏爾關與克爾阿的具身力 量，糾纏著痛苦的記憶。
他們會對這些話產生反應。
住手！你們這樣對待我們是 錯的！為什麼要做這種事？

entries.label: ARILOU_HINTS_4
entries.body: The enemy of your enemy is your friend... at least for a time.
entries.source: The enemy of your enemy is your friend... at least for a time.
entries.translation: 敵人的敵人就是朋友…… 至少暫時如此。

entries.label: bye_friendly_space
entries.body: Goodbye Arilou.
entries.source: Goodbye Arilou.
entries.translation: 再見，阿里盧。

entries.label: GOODBYE_FRIENDLY_SPACE
entries.body: Farewell child.
entries.source: Farewell child.
entries.translation: 再會了，孩子。

entries.label: GOT_PART_YET_1
entries.body:
The prospect of sharing the easy way with you excites us.
If you have found the Ur-Quan Warp Pod, this prospect can be made a reality.
entries.source:
The prospect of sharing the easy way with you excites us.
If you have found the Ur-Quan Warp Pod, this prospect can be made a reality.
entries.translation:
一想到能與你分享捷徑， 我們就十分興奮。
只要你已找到烏爾關的躍遷 艙，這個想法就能成真。

entries.label: GOT_PART_YET_2
entries.body:
We are so eager to give you our means to traverse reality.
Have you obtained the Warp Pod yet?
entries.source:
We are so eager to give you our means to traverse reality.
Have you obtained the Warp Pod yet?
entries.translation:
我們迫不及待想把穿越現實 的方法交給你。
你拿到躍遷艙了嗎？

entries.label: INIT_ANGRY_HWLD_HELLO
entries.body:
You have found our world. We did not see this
and now it is too late to adjust without damage
but perhaps the situation can be resolved in another way.
The answer lies within your next statement.
entries.source:
You have found our world. We did not see this
and now it is too late to adjust without damage
but perhaps the situation can be resolved in another way.
The answer lies within your next statement.
entries.translation:
你找到了我們的世界。 我們沒有預見此事
如今若想調整， 已經來不及避免傷害
但也許能用另一種方式化解 局勢。
答案就在你的下一句話裡。

entries.label: invaders_from_mars
entries.body: You guys are like... invaders from Mars! Weird evil monsters!
entries.source: You guys are like... invaders from Mars! Weird evil monsters!
entries.translation: 你們這些傢伙簡直像…… 火星入侵者！詭異的邪惡怪 物！

entries.label: HAD_OUR_REASONS
entries.body:
No. We seek not to invade, but to pervade. There is a difference.
Your stories of evil creatures... these are just... side effects.
Pay them no heed.
entries.source:
No. We seek not to invade, but to pervade. There is a difference.
Your stories of evil creatures... these are just... side effects.
Pay them no heed.
entries.translation:
不。我們並非想要入侵， 而是滲透。兩者有所不同。
你那些邪惡生物的故事…… 只是……副作用。
不必理會。

entries.label: bug_eyed_fruitcakes
entries.body: No-no-no-no-no! I'll stop you! You bug-eyed fruitcakes have mutilated your last cow!
entries.source: No-no-no-no-no! I'll stop you! You bug-eyed fruitcakes have mutilated your last cow!
entries.translation: 不－不－不－不－不！ 我要阻止你們！ 你們這群凸眼瘋子再也別想 肢解任何一頭牛！

entries.label: WE_NEVER_FRIENDS
entries.body:
We have sought amiable companionship with you, Captain
when we just as easily could have performed such experiments on you.
We shall not fight with our children. Goodbye.
entries.source:
We have sought amiable companionship with you, Captain
when we just as easily could have performed such experiments on you.
We shall not fight with our children. Goodbye.
entries.translation:
我們一直友善地尋求你的陪 伴，船長
儘管我們大可同樣輕易地在 你身上進行這類實驗。
我們不會和自己的孩子交 戰。再見。

entries.label: ok_lets_be_friends
entries.body: Look, I'm sorry. I made some mistakes. We need you as allies, not as enemies.
entries.source: Look, I'm sorry. I made some mistakes. We need you as allies, not as enemies.
entries.translation: 聽著，對不起。 我犯了些錯。我們需要你當 盟友，不是敵人。

entries.label: NO_ALLY_BUT_MUCH_GIVE
entries.body:
We have never been your enemy, though your people may once have thought so.
But we are also not your ally. That would require a degree of involvement in this *time*
which is not presently permissible.
For now, we are simply your friends... who have much to give.
entries.source:
We have never been your enemy, though your people may once have thought so.
But we are also not your ally. That would require a degree of involvement in this *time*
which is not presently permissible.
For now, we are simply your friends... who have much to give.
entries.translation:
我們從來不是你的敵人， 儘管你們族人以前或許如此 認為。
但我們也不是你的盟友。 那需要在這個*時間*介入 到一定程度
而目前並不允許這樣做。
現在，我們只是你的朋 友……而且有許多東西能給 你。

entries.label: why_should_i_trust
entries.body: Why should I trust you? You did funny things to that horror writer a while ago, right?
entries.source: Why should I trust you? You did funny things to that horror writer a while ago, right?
entries.translation: 我為什麼該信任你？ 你們前陣子對那個恐怖小說 家做過怪事，對吧？

entries.label: TRUST_BECAUSE
entries.body:
We do many things, few of them funny... at least by our standards.
You do not, CANNOT understand some of what we do, or why.
Therefore it may be best if you simply consider us... quirky.
entries.source:
We do many things, few of them funny... at least by our standards.
You do not, CANNOT understand some of what we do, or why.
Therefore it may be best if you simply consider us... quirky.
entries.translation:
我們做過很多事， 但沒幾件算得上好笑…… 至少按照我們的標準。
你並不理解，也不可能理解 我們某些行為或背後的理 由。
所以，你最好只把我們想 成……有點古怪。

entries.label: what_about_interference
entries.body: What gives your people the right to interfere with mine?
entries.source: What gives your people the right to interfere with mine?
entries.translation: 你們族人憑什麼干涉我的族 人？

entries.label: INTERFERENCE_NECESSARY
entries.body:
What gives you the right to move, the right to fall?
Some acts are motivated, others are automatic.
Do not presume that you can decide which is which for anyone but yourself
or you will be... disappointed.
entries.source:
What gives you the right to move, the right to fall?
Some acts are motivated, others are automatic.
Do not presume that you can decide which is which for anyone but yourself
or you will be... disappointed.
entries.translation:
你憑什麼移動， 又憑什麼墜落？
有些行為出於動機， 有些則自動發生。
不要妄想自己有權替除了你 以外的任何人判斷兩者之別
否則你會……失望。

entries.label: i_just_like_to_leave
entries.body: Ok, fine, whatever. Just let me leave now, okay?
entries.source: Ok, fine, whatever. Just let me leave now, okay?
entries.translation: 好吧，隨便啦。 現在讓我離開，好嗎？

entries.label: SORRY_NO_LEAVE
entries.body:
This matter must be resolved, or many event strands will grow... more complicated.
Your presence is required.
entries.source:
This matter must be resolved, or many event strands will grow... more complicated.
Your presence is required.
entries.translation:
此事必須解決， 否則許多事件脈絡會變 得……更加複雜。
你必須留下。

entries.label: what_about_war
entries.body: So what DID happen at the end of the War?
entries.source: So what DID happen at the end of the War?
entries.translation: 那麼，大戰結束時究竟發生 了什麼事？

entries.label: ABOUT_WAR
entries.body:
Forgive us if we forget the importance you attach to such events as this.
Our... context, is infinitely broader than yours in scope, both in space and *time*.
Nevertheless, to please you I shall try to recall
yes, now I remember. Here is the sequence
the Ur-Quan fleets have moved through your solar system and you are defeated
your people make the choice not to fight with and for the Ur-Quan
A shield is cast about your world. Your people are now safe. This makes us happy.
The Armada departs your star system and moves toward the remaining Alliance members
ourselves, the Syreen, the Yehat and their adopted Shofixti.
The Yehat and Shofixti withdraw to Delta Gorno, but they do not permit the Syreen to follow.
We are content with the flow of events and leave the area to return here.
From our perspective, this sequence of events ends here.

entries.translation:
若我們忘了你如此看重這類 事件，還請原諒。
我們的……脈絡， 無論空間或*時間*， 範圍都比你廣闊無窮。
不過為了讓你高興， 我會試著回想
對，現在想起來了。 順序是這樣的
烏爾關艦隊穿越你們的太陽 系，你們戰敗
你們的人民選擇不與烏爾關 並肩作戰，也不為他們作戰
一道護盾籠罩你們的世界。 你們的人民如今安全了。 這讓我們很高興。
無敵艦隊離開你們的星系， 轉向剩餘的聯盟成員
也就是我們、賽琳、 耶哈特，以及他們收養的索 菲克斯提。
耶哈特與索菲克斯提撤往 Delta Gorno，但不允許賽琳 跟隨。
我們對事件的流向很滿意， 於是離開該區域返回這裡。
從我們的觀點來看， 這一連串事件到此結束。

entries.label: what_about_urquan
entries.body: Well what about the Ur-Quan? What are they up to?
entries.source: Well what about the Ur-Quan? What are they up to?
entries.translation: 那烏爾關呢？他們在做什 麼？

entries.label: ABOUT_URQUAN
entries.body:
Soon after the Ur-Quan defeated the Yehat and imprisoned the Syreen in Betelgeuse
their siblings arrived to initiate the Doctrinal Conflict.
This battle continues as we speak.
entries.source:
Soon after the Ur-Quan defeated the Yehat and imprisoned the Syreen in Betelgeuse
their siblings arrived to initiate the Doctrinal Conflict.
This battle continues as we speak.
entries.translation:
烏爾關擊敗耶哈特， 並將賽琳囚禁在 Betelgeuse 後不久
他們的手足便抵達， 展開教義衝突。
這場戰鬥此刻仍在持續。

entries.label: best_if_i_killed_you
entries.body: I think it would be best if I killed you now.
entries.source: I think it would be best if I killed you now.
entries.translation: 我想現在殺了你最好。

entries.label: WICKED_HUMAN
entries.body: Instinct. Instinct. Instinct. Always the instinct.
entries.source: Instinct. Instinct. Instinct. Always the instinct.
entries.translation: 本能。本能。本能。 永遠都是本能。

entries.label: what_did_on_earth
entries.body: What, exactly, have you been doing on Earth?
entries.source: What, exactly, have you been doing on Earth?
entries.translation: 你們到底在地球上做了些什 麼？

entries.label: DID_THIS
entries.body:
You desire honesty. It is given.
We have visited your world for many thousands of years into your species' past.
We have changed things... made modifications.
entries.source:
You desire honesty. It is given.
We have visited your world for many thousands of years into your species' past.
We have changed things... made modifications.
entries.translation:
你渴望坦白。那就給你坦 白。
在你們物種過去的數千年 間，我們一直造訪你們的世 界。
我們改變了一些事物…… 做了一些調整。

entries.label: why_did_this
entries.body: What did you change and modify on Earth, AND WHY?!
entries.source: What did you change and modify on Earth, AND WHY?!
entries.translation: 你們在地球上改變、 調整了什麼？還有為什 麼？！

entries.label: IDF_PARASITES
entries.body:
Our motives are multiple, our desires complex.
Part of what we do on Earth is for your own protection.
There are parasites. Creatures who dwell Beyond.
They have names, but you do not know them. They would like to find you
but they are blind to your presence... unless you show yourselves.
The Androsynth showed themselves, and something noticed them.
There are no more Androsynth now. Only Orz.
entries.source:
Our motives are multiple, our desires complex.
Part of what we do on Earth is for your own protection.
There are parasites. Creatures who dwell Beyond.
They have names, but you do not know them. They would like to find you

entries.translation:
我們的動機很多， 欲望也很複雜。
我們在地球上的部分作為， 是為了保護你們。
有一些寄生者。 居於彼方的生物。
牠們有名字，但你不知道。 牠們很想找到你們
卻看不見你們的存在…… 除非你們暴露自己。
安德羅辛斯暴露了自己， 於是某個東西注意到了他 們。
現在已沒有安德羅辛斯。 只有奧茲。

entries.label: tell_more
entries.body: This sounds creepy. Please go on.
entries.source: This sounds creepy. Please go on.
entries.translation: 這聽起來毛骨悚然。 請繼續。

entries.label: NOT_NOW
entries.body:
No. In a way, ignorance is your armor, your best protection.
They cannot see you now. They cannot smell you.
Much of our work with your people involved making you invisible... changing your smell.
If I tell you more, you will look where you could never look before
and while you are looking you can and will be seen.
You do not want to be seen.
entries.source:
No. In a way, ignorance is your armor, your best protection.
They cannot see you now. They cannot smell you.
Much of our work with your people involved making you invisible... changing your smell.
If I tell you more, you will look where you could never look before
and while you are looking you can and will be seen.
You do not want to be seen.
entries.translation:
不。就某方面而言， 無知是你的鎧甲， 是最好的防護。
牠們現在看不見你。 也聞不到你。
我們在人類身上做的許多工 作，都為了讓你們隱形…… 改變你們的氣味。
如果再告訴你更多， 你就會看向以前根本無法看 見的地方
而當你注視時，你就可能、 也必然會被看見。
你不會想被看見。

entries.label: umgah_acting_weird
entries.body: We have met the Umgah, and they are acting extremely weird, like zombie-blobbies!
entries.source: We have met the Umgah, and they are acting extremely weird, like zombie-blobbies!
entries.translation: 我們見過烏姆加， 而他們的舉止詭異到極點， 簡直像殭屍軟團！

entries.label: learned_about_umgah
entries.body: Have you learned anything about the Umgah yet?
entries.source: Have you learned anything about the Umgah yet?
entries.translation: 你查出烏姆加的任何事情了 嗎？

entries.label: WELL_GO_CHECK
entries.body:
Hmmm... this is disturbing news. They are normally rambunctious to an extreme.
We will send ships to Umgah space to investigate.
We should have some answers in a few days time.
entries.source:
Hmmm... this is disturbing news. They are normally rambunctious to an extreme.
We will send ships to Umgah space to investigate.
We should have some answers in a few days time.
entries.translation:
嗯……這消息令人不安。 他們平常總是活潑得過了 頭。
我們會派船前往烏姆加空域 調查。
幾天後應該就會有答案。

entries.label: NO_NEWS_YET
entries.body:
Our exploration skiffs have not returned. We are concerned.
Perhaps if you ask later, we will know then.
entries.source:
Our exploration skiffs have not returned. We are concerned.
Perhaps if you ask later, we will know then.
entries.translation:
我們的探索小艇尚未返回。 我們很擔心。
也許稍後再問， 屆時我們就會知道。

entries.label: UMGAH_UNDER_COMPULSION
entries.body:
We have discovered something strange and frightening about the Umgah
When we approached their vessels, we were instantly attacked
and the Umgah made no attempts to contact our ships or respond to our hails.
Using our own psionic sensitivities, we determined that they are under some form of psychic compulsion.
The source of psionic control commands appears to be Beta Orionis, the Umgah's home star.
We sent vessels to investigate this location, but none have returned... we fear they are destroyed.
entries.source:
We have discovered something strange and frightening about the Umgah

and the Umgah made no attempts to contact our ships or respond to our hails.
Using our own psionic sensitivities, we determined that they are under some form of psychic compulsion.

entries.translation:
我們發現烏姆加身上有某種 奇怪而可怕的狀況
接近他們的船艦時， 我們立刻遭到攻擊
而烏姆加完全沒試著聯絡我 方船艦，也不回應呼叫。
我們運用自身的靈能感知， 判斷他們正受到某種精神強 迫。
靈能控制命令的來源， 似乎是烏姆加的母星 Beta Orionis。
我們曾派船調查該處， 但沒有一艘返回…… 恐怕都被摧毀了。

entries.label: what_do_now
entries.body: So what can we do about the psychically zombified blobbies?
entries.source: So what can we do about the psychically zombified blobbies?
entries.translation: 那我們該怎麼處理這群被精 神控制成殭屍的軟團？

entries.label: GO_FIND_OUT
entries.body:
We have had no success with our own investigations.
Whatever controls the Umgah is a threat, but we seem unprepared to deal with it.
Perhaps you and your crew are better suited to this mission.
If you choose to go to Beta Orionis, take care, child
whatever controls the Umgah now knows of our presence
and it may take measures against us.
entries.source:
We have had no success with our own investigations.
Whatever controls the Umgah is a threat, but we seem unprepared to deal with it.
Perhaps you and your crew are better suited to this mission.
If you choose to go to Beta Orionis, take care, child
whatever controls the Umgah now knows of our presence
and it may take measures against us.
entries.translation:
我們自己的調查毫無進展。
無論控制烏姆加的是什麼， 它都是威脅，而我們似乎尚 無力應付。
也許你和船員更適合執行這 項任務。
如果決定前往 Beta Orionis， 務必小心，孩子
如今控制烏姆加的東西已知 道我們的存在
而且可能會採取手段對付我 們。

entries.label: tell_arilou_about_tpet
entries.body:
The source of the Umgah's compulsion is the Talking Pet you gave the Umgah,
but now it is intelligent and exhibits strange powers.
entries.source:
The source of the Umgah's compulsion is the Talking Pet you gave the Umgah,
but now it is intelligent and exhibits strange powers.
entries.translation:
烏姆加受到控制的源頭， 就是你們交給他們的會說話 的寵物
但牠如今有了智慧， 還展現出奇異能力。

entries.label: BAD_NEWS_ABOUT_TPET
entries.body:
That is very bad news. This creature, a super-intelligent, physically coercive creature
is very similar to a race of beings which was thought to have vanished over 20,000 years ago.
They were called the Dnyarri, and history tells that they ruled a wide region of this galaxy
for many thousands of years. The Dnyarri were cruel and devious
and when they were finally overthrown by one of their slave-races
they were supposedly exterminated.
Perhaps this Talking Pet is the degenerate product of the Dnyarri.

entries.translation:
這是非常糟糕的消息。 這種擁有超高智慧、 能以精神強迫他者的生物
與一個據信在兩萬多年前滅 絕的種族極為相似。
他們叫迪納里；歷史記載， 他們曾統治銀河一大片區域
長達數千年。迪納里既殘酷 又狡詐
最後終於被其中一個奴隸種 族推翻時
據說已遭到滅絕。
也許這隻會說話的寵物， 正是迪納里退化後的產物。

entries.label: what_do_about_tpet
entries.body: So what should we do about this Dnyarri creature?
entries.source: So what should we do about this Dnyarri creature?
entries.translation: 那我們該怎麼處理這個迪納 里生物？

entries.label: DANGEROUS_BUT_USEFUL
entries.body:
The Dnyarri were the most inimical race this galaxy has known.
In other dimensions, other *times* there are far, far worse beings
but they do not threaten you at the present time.
During their reign, the Dnyarri possessed absolute power over all intelligent species in this region.
They used their slaves for all menial tasks and many forms of depraved entertainment.
If the Talking Pet we gave to the Umgah has attained the coercive abilities of its ancestors
we must assume that other Talking Pets can do likewise.
Therefore the creature must be considered the most dangerous being in the galaxy.
Its destruction is necessary... unless
you can find some way to gain control over the creature!
If you could do this you would have a powerful weapon against the Ur-Quan.
Of course, if you made one mistake, you would be the Dnyarri's slave forever.

entries.translation:
迪納里是這個銀河所知最具 敵意的種族。
在其他維度、其他*時間* 裡，還有遠遠、 遠遠更可怕的存在
但目前他們並不威脅你們。
迪納里統治時， 對這片區域的所有智慧種族 都握有絕對控制力。
他們讓奴隸處理一切卑賤工 作，也供自己從事各種墮落 娛樂。
如果我們交給烏姆加的會說 話的寵物，已經獲得祖先的 強迫能力
就必須假設其他會說話的寵 物也能做到。
因此，必須把這個生物視為 銀河中最危險的存在。
有必要將牠摧毀……除非
你能找到控制這個生物的辦 法！
如果辦得到，你便會擁有對 抗烏爾關的強大武器。
當然，只要犯下一個錯誤， 你就會永遠成為迪納里的奴 隸。

entries.label: what_give_me
entries.body: You said you had much to give my people. Can you be more specific?
entries.source: You said you had much to give my people. Can you be more specific?
entries.translation: 你說有許多東西能給我的人 民。可以說得更具體嗎？

entries.label: ABOUT_PORTAL
entries.body:
As you know, we live in a dimension adjacent to HyperSpace which we call QuasiSpace.
Our ships move between these dimensions through weaknesses in the inter-dimensional fabric.
Although many such weaknesses, or Portals, exist which lead from our dimension, QuasiSpace
to various locations in HyperSpace, there is only one naturally occurring Portal
which will transport a ship from HyperSpace to QuasiSpace.
We therefore find it convenient to generate our own Portals artificially
with focused dimensional fatigue rays.
As a sign of our long-standing relationship with your species
we would happily fit your vessel with a Portal spawner of its own
but your ship is so massive, our units would be ineffective. However
we suspect you may find a sufficiently powerful warp pod, the key element in a Portal spawner
in the wreck of the Ur-Quan Dreadnought on the seventh world at Alpha Pavonis.
Bring that warp pod back here, and we will prepare a Portal spawner for your vessel.

entries.translation:
如你所知，我們住在與超空 間相鄰的維度， 稱為準空間。
我們的船艦會利用跨維度結 構中的薄弱處， 在這些維度之間移動。
雖然有許多這類薄弱處， 也就是傳送門， 能從我們的準空間維度
通往超空間各處， 但天然存在的傳送門只有一 座
能將船艦從超空間送往準空 間。
所以，我們發現用聚焦的維 度疲勞射線
人工生成自己的傳送門， 相當方便。
為了表達與你們物種長久以 來的情誼
我們很樂意替你的船裝上一 具傳送門生成器
但你的船太過巨大， 我們的裝置無法發揮作用。 不過
我們猜想，你能在 Alpha Pavonis 第七行星上的烏爾關無畏艦 殘骸中
找到威力足夠的躍遷艙， 也就是傳送門生成器的核心 元件。
把那具躍遷艙帶回這裡， 我們就會為你的船準備傳送 門生成器。

entries.label: what_about_tpet
entries.body: You mentioned a Talking Pet. How did you find one?
entries.source: You mentioned a Talking Pet. How did you find one?
entries.translation: 你提到一隻會說話的寵物。 你們怎麼找到牠的？

entries.label: ABOUT_TPET
entries.body:
We are an endlessly curious species, and we spend much of our time on
how should I say, reconnaissance missions.
During one such trip, we witnessed the crash landing of an Ur-Quan Dreadnought
on the surface of Alpha Pavonis VII.
Normally, when an Ur-Quan vessel is disabled, it automatically engages self-annihilation circuits
to prevent other species from learning the Ur-Quan's technological secrets.
In this case, however, these circuits must have failed. The Dreadnought did not disintegrate on impact.
We landed to explore the wreckage, and were amazed to find a survivor... a Talking Pet!
As you may know, the Ur-Quan use these non-sentient creatures for the task of inter-species translation
a task the Ur-Quan find ultimately demeaning.
The Talking Pet was severely injured, and we did what we could for the poor creature
but it grew clear that without superior measures, the Talking Pet would die.
We turned to the Umgah, whom we have known for many centuries.
Their bioscience skills are far superior to our own.
The Umgah promised to do what they could, and let us know how the Pet fared.
We have not heard from the Umgah since.
Perhaps if you are travelling through their stars, you can ask them for us.

entries.translation:
我們是永遠充滿好奇的物 種，花了許多時間進行
該怎麼說呢，偵察任務。
某趟旅程中，我們目睹一艘 烏爾關無畏艦
墜落在 Alpha Pavonis VII 的表面。
一般而言，烏爾關船艦一旦 癱瘓，就會自動啟動自毀迴 路
以免其他種族得知烏爾關的 科技祕密。
但那一次，這些迴路想必失 效了。無畏艦並未在撞擊時 解體。
我們降落探索殘骸， 驚訝地找到一名生還者…… 一隻會說話的寵物！
你或許知道，烏爾關利用這 些無感知力的生物進行跨物 種翻譯
這是烏爾關認為極其有失身 分的工作。
會說話的寵物傷勢極重， 我們盡力幫助這可憐的生物
但情況越來越明顯： 若沒有更高明的手段， 牠一定會死。
於是，我們轉向已相識數百 年的烏姆加求助。
他們的生物科學技術遠勝我 們。
烏姆加答應盡力而為， 並告知寵物後續的狀況。
從此我們再也沒有收到烏姆 加的消息。
如果你會經過他們的星域， 也許可以替我們問問。

entries.label: about_portal_again
entries.body: Can you tell me about that Portal Spawner thing again?
entries.source: Can you tell me about that Portal Spawner thing again?
entries.translation: 你能再說一次那個傳送門生 成器嗎？

entries.label: PORTAL_AGAIN
entries.body:
Certainly. As a sign of our long-standing friendship with your species
we would be happy to fit your vessel with a Portal spawner
allowing you to jump from place to place in HyperSpace, without travelling the intervening distance.
However, your ship is so massive, our normal warp pod units are insufficient
but you will find a sufficiently powerful warp pod in the wreck of the Ur-Quan Dreadnought
on Alpha Pavonis VII. Bring that warp pod back here, and we will prepare a Portal spawner for your vessel.

當然。為了表達與你們物種 長久以來的情誼
我們很樂意替你的船裝上一 具傳送門生成器
讓你不必穿越中間的距離， 就能從超空間一處跳往另一 處。
但你的船太過巨大， 我們平常使用的躍遷艙裝置 並不足夠
不過你能在 Alpha Pavonis VII 的烏爾關無畏艦殘骸中， 找到威力足夠的躍遷艙。
把那具躍遷艙帶回這裡， 我們就會為你的船準備傳送 門生成器。

entries.label: got_it
entries.body: I have obtained the Warp Pod unit from the Ur-Quan wreck.
entries.source: I have obtained the Warp Pod unit from the Ur-Quan wreck.
entries.translation: 我已經從烏爾關殘骸取得躍 遷艙裝置。

entries.label: CLEVER_HUMAN
entries.body:
What a surprise!
As we have always said, Humans are a MOST resourceful and clever species.
We are so proud of you! But don't worry that you shall have to wait.
entries.source:
What a surprise!
As we have always said, Humans are a MOST resourceful and clever species.
We are so proud of you! But don't worry that you shall have to wait.
entries.translation:
真令人驚喜！
正如我們一向所說， 人類是最足智多謀、 最聰明的物種。
我們真以你為榮！ 而且別擔心，你不必等待。

entries.label: GIVE_PORTAL
entries.body:
We are prepared. Even now our technical personnel are equipping your ship
with a custom version of our Portal spawner device.
The device is useable only in HyperSpace. Whenever it is activated
the spawner will focus several inter-dimensional fatigue beams adjacent to your vessel
opening a temporary hole into QuasiSpace. Move quickly through the Portal!
After your ship has passed into QuasiSpace, you can choose any of the nearby Portals
which lead back to HyperSpace, thus saving you needless transit time.
Be keenly aware of this fact! The Spawner requires a great deal of energy to function.
We estimate that each time you use the device, it will consume ten of your fuel units.

我們已經準備妥當。此刻， 技術人員正在你的船上
安裝特製版傳送門生成裝 置。
這具裝置只能在超空間使 用。每次啟動時
生成器都會把數道跨維度疲 勞光束聚焦在你的船旁
打開一個通往準空間的暫時 孔洞。快點穿過傳送門！
船艦進入準空間後， 你可以選擇附近任何一座
通往超空間的傳送門， 省去不必要的航行時間。
務必牢記這項事實！ 生成器運作需要大量能量。
我們估計，每次使用裝置都 會消耗十個燃料單位。

entries.label: bye_friendly_homeworld
entries.body: Goodbye my Arilou friends.
entries.source: Goodbye my Arilou friends.
entries.translation: 再見了，我的阿里盧朋友。

entries.label: GOODBYE_FRDLY_HOMEWORLD
entries.body: Goodbye clever child.
entries.source: Goodbye clever child.
entries.translation: 再見了，聰明的孩子。

entries.label: HOSTILE_GOODBYE_1
entries.body:
We have said all there is to be said.
We would prefer your immediate departure, but are prepared for your attack.
entries.source:
We have said all there is to be said.
We would prefer your immediate departure, but are prepared for your attack.
entries.translation:
該說的都已經說完了。
我們希望你立刻離開， 但也準備好面對攻擊。

entries.label: HOSTILE_GOODBYE_2
entries.body:
Your behavior is clearly inimical. We resist discorporation.
Further contact between ourselves is pointless.
entries.source:
Your behavior is clearly inimical. We resist discorporation.
Further contact between ourselves is pointless.
entries.translation:
你的行為顯然充滿敵意。 我們抗拒脫離肉身。
我們之間再繼續接觸也毫無 意義。

entries.label: HOSTILE_GOODBYE_3
entries.body: Seek death in other corners. Leave us.
entries.source: Seek death in other corners. Leave us.
entries.translation: 去其他角落尋死。離開。

entries.label: HOSTILE_GOODBYE_4
entries.body: Seek death in other corners. Leave us.
entries.source: Seek death in other corners. Leave us.
entries.translation: 去其他角落尋死。離開。

entries.label: ANGRY_SPACE_HELLO_1
entries.body:
We cannot fathom your reason, therefore you must be acting upon simple instinct.
Perhaps this is our fault. We have always loved instinct
even though we possess none ourselves.
Do you have too much instinct, human? Does your species? We shall see.

entries.translation:
我們無法理解你的理由， 所以你一定只是受單純本能 驅使。
也許這是我們的錯。 我們始終熱愛本能
儘管自己完全沒有本能。
人類，你的本能太多了嗎？ 你的物種也是嗎？ 我們會看清楚。

entries.label: ANGRY_SPACE_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Human. You flail at the wind. Cease your violence.
Would you hurt your pet? Your child? Your beast?
Please... rethink your posture.
entries.source:
Human. You flail at the wind. Cease your violence.
Would you hurt your pet? Your child? Your beast?
Please... rethink your posture.
entries.translation:
人類。你只是在對著風胡亂 揮舞。停止暴力。
你會傷害自己的寵物嗎？ 自己的孩子？自己的野獸？
拜託……重新考慮你的姿 態。

entries.label: lets_fight
entries.body: C'mon, let's fight... Freak Face!
entries.source: C'mon, let's fight... Freak Face!
entries.translation: 來啊，打一場……怪胎臉！

entries.label: NO_FIGHT
entries.body: We will never choose to fight you, child.
entries.source: We will never choose to fight you, child.
entries.translation: 我們永遠不會選擇和你交 戰，孩子。

entries.label: im_sorry
entries.body: Aughhh! I am sorry! WHAT WAS I THINKING?!!
entries.source: Aughhh! I am sorry! WHAT WAS I THINKING?!!
entries.translation: 啊啊啊！對不起！ 我到底在想什麼？！！

entries.label: APOLOGIZE_AT_HOMEWORLD
entries.body:
If you wish to make atonement... seek a strangely shaped rock or plant.
However, should you wish to change the nature of our relationship
seek the Arilou in QuasiSpace. You can make the transit at 43.8 : 637.2
but only when the door is open.

若想贖罪……去尋找一塊形 狀奇特的岩石或植物。

就到準空間尋找阿里盧。 你可以在 43.8 : 637.2 穿越
但只限門戶開啟時。

entries.label: bye_angry_space
entries.body: G'bye.
entries.source: G'bye.
entries.translation: 再會。

entries.label: GOODBYE_ANGRY_SPACE
entries.body: When you have resolved your conflict, we shall speak again.
entries.source: When you have resolved your conflict, we shall speak again.
entries.translation: 等你解決自身的衝突， 我們會再次交談。

entries.label: OUT_TAKES
entries.body:
Do you really believe Project Bluebook revealed EVERYTHING the Army Air Corps knew?
Do you know what REALLY happened at Roswell, New Mexico in the late 1940's?
Have you even heard about the Men in Black?
Do you have any friends who have `missing days'?
Do you sleep with your window unlocked?
Be seeing you...

你真的相信藍皮書計畫揭露 了陸軍航空隊知道的一切 嗎？
